description: CockroachDB topology and options: version, node count, locality, TLS mode.

fields.description: Server series; the binary is pulled per release train (LTS lines get a year of maintenance plus a year of assistance).
fields.name: version
fields.title: CockroachDB version

fields.description: Homogeneous cluster size; 1 for a single-node stand, otherwise an odd number >= 3 so Raft can hold a majority.
fields.name: nodes
fields.title: Nodes

fields.description: --locality for each node, in node order; leave empty for a flat cluster. When set it must have exactly one entry per node and every entry must use the same keys in the same order.

items.description: One node's --locality value: comma-separated key=value pairs, most inclusive first.

fields.name: locality
fields.title: Per-node locality

fields.description: Start with --insecure: no TLS and no authentication. Default on — a throwaway benchmark stand should measure the engine, not the handshake.
fields.name: insecure
fields.title: Insecure mode

fields.description: HAProxy instances spreading SQL clients over the nodes (cockroach gen haproxy produces an equivalent config).
fields.name: haproxy
fields.title: HAProxy nodes

fields.description: SQL executed against the cluster once it is initialized, before the workload.
fields.name: init_sql
fields.title: Init SQL

rules.message: a cluster is either a single node or an odd number of at least 3 (Raft majority)
locality must be empty or carry exactly one entry per node
HAProxy in front of a single node only adds a hop
